description: This file declares classes related to AWC (Application Window Controller) state change listening and notification within the Thunder::ProcessContainers namespace. It defines interfaces and classes for handling state change events, managing listeners, and integrating with the AWCClient.

classes.name: AWCStateChangeListener
classes.description: Interface for listening to AWC state change events.

classes.name: AWCStateChangeNotifier
classes.description: Class responsible for managing AWCStateChangeListener instances and notifying them of state changes.

classes.name: AWCListener
classes.description: Implementation of AWCClient::Listener that forwards events to an AWCStateChangeNotifier.

methods.name: addListener
methods.description: Adds a listener to the notifier.

methods.name: removeListener
methods.description: Removes a listener from the notifier.

methods.name: notify
methods.description: Notifies all registered listeners of a state change.

methods.name: AWCListener(AWCStateChangeNotifier * notifier)
methods.description: Constructor for AWCListener, associating it with a notifier.

methods.name: notifyWindowChange
methods.description: Called when a window change occurs.

methods.name: notifyStateChange
methods.description: Called when an application state change occurs.

methods.name: notifyServiceReady
methods.description: Called when the AWC service is ready.
